# llms.txt for HiveIO (Hive Fabric)
# Source: https://www.hiveio.com/
# Last Updated: 2026-04-23

> HiveIO is a comprehensive, all-in-one virtualization platform for VDI (Virtual Desktop Infrastructure), VSI (Virtual Server Infrastructure), HCI (Hyper-Converged Infrastructure), and Edge Computing. Built on the open-source KVM hypervisor, Hive Fabric delivers enterprise-grade desktop, server, and storage virtualization at a fraction of traditional costs, with simplicity at its core.

HiveIO was founded with the goal of creating an advanced cloud computing paradigm that is cost-effective and simple to operate. With 25+ years of experience managing virtualization platforms and clients in 19+ countries, HiveIO serves sectors including healthcare, education, banking, telecommunications, manufacturing, legal services, call centers, and engineering.

## Core Product: Hive Fabric

- [Hive Fabric Latest Release 8.6.2](https://www.hiveio.com/hive-fabric-8-6-2/)

**Current Version:** 8.6.2: 
Hive Fabric is HiveIO's flagship software-defined data center solution. It integrates all essential components for HCI, VDI, and general virtualization deployments into a single platform with one vendor, one contract, and one 24/7 support team.

### Key Capabilities

- **KVM Hypervisor Foundation**: Built on the industry-leading open-source KVM hypervisor, widely adopted across hundreds of thousands of servers and supported by major tech companies and cloud providers.
- **Storage Options**: Local RAM and DISK filesystems, NFS, CIFS, Hyper-Converged Storage, iSCSI, Fiber Channel, and cloud storage (S3, Azure).
- **Software-Defined Networking**: Supports 1GB to 100GB+ network infrastructures; allows business-defined network segmentation and protection.
- **Message Bus Orchestration**: Built-in intelligent orchestration layer that autonomously manages infrastructure and virtual desktops, logs every transaction for real-time visibility, anomaly detection, and compliance. AI-driven resource distribution eliminates manual IT decision-making.
- **Desktop Broker**: Unified deployment logic for stateless and persistent desktops; supports secure remote access to virtual and physical desktops and servers. Clients include Windows native, Linux native, and HTML5 browser-based RDP sessions.
- **Profile Management & GPU Acceleration**: Patent-pending profile management for consistent desktop personalization; built-in GPU support for NVIDIA and Intel for high-performance application delivery.
- **Single Pane of Glass Management**: Intuitive web UI powered by the real-time Message Bus for infrastructure health monitoring and performance visibility.
- **Hive Sense**: Proactive cloud-based monitoring platform that uploads configuration backups and logs, enabling proactive support and anomaly alerting.
- **Open REST API**: Seamless integration with enterprise monitoring, reporting, and automation tools.

### Deployment Architectures

- Edge Computing
- On-Premises
- Multi-Tenant / Hosted / DaaS (Desktop as a Service)
- Remote Office / Branch Office (ROBO)
- Multi-Site

## Solutions 

- [Solutions](https://www.hiveio.com/daas/)

- **DaaS (Desktop as a Service)**: Hosted virtual desktop delivery for organizations and MSPs. HiveIO manages hardware, datacenter, and virtualization infrastructure; customers retain control over Active Directory, OS/app management, desktop templates, and assignments. A full white-glove managed service option is also available.
- **Secure Virtual Workspaces**: Isolated, policy-controlled virtual desktops for secure access.
- **Cost-Optimized Infrastructure**: Combined VDI and HCI licensing on commodity hardware reduces TCO significantly.
- **Scalable Bare-Metal Platform**: Scales effortlessly from single-node community deployments to large enterprise clusters.
- **Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery**: Desktop disaster recovery and swift recovery capabilities; supports multi-site failover.
- **Seamless User Experience**: Profile persistence, GPU acceleration, and optimized protocols for end-user performance.
- **DaaS for MSPs**: Multi-tenant hosted desktop delivery for Managed Service Providers.

## Licensing & Pricing

- [Licensing & Pricing](https://hiveio.com/demo)

- Licensed by CPU Core or by VM
- Payment options: monthly, annual, or multi-year prepayment
- No large upfront investment required
- Free Community Edition available (single-host, unlimited VM creation)
- All subscriptions include 24/7 remote support at no extra cost

## Why HiveIO?

- [Why HiveIO?](https://www.hiveio.com/about-hiveio/)

- VMware alternative: Combined VDI + HCI licensing on commodity hardware; customers report significant cost savings and zero-downtime migrations from VMware.
- No proprietary hardware lock-in; runs on standard x86 commodity servers.
- No additional components or external databases required for orchestration.
- 25+ years of enterprise virtualization expertise.
- Clients in 19+ countries across diverse verticals.
